balls.text: What a finish! Delhi seemed to have done well in the last few overs to drag back the run -rate but Yuvraj singh has finished off in some style. It was the bouncer, Yuvraj seemed to be ready for it and crash-pulled it way over midwicket

the quick bouncer and Yuvraj is late on the pull. The ball flies past Yuvraj. After a short delay, the square-leg ump says that will be a wide. It went just over Yuvraj's head. Sehwag has a chat with the ump.
Thwack! It was a length delivery outside off and Yuvraj flat-batted it violently over long-on
A shot from Yuvraj poster. The front foot was cleared outside leg, the back knee was bent a little and that big at swing came crashing down to send the ball flying over wide long-on
Sehwag holds his head. . It was the slower bouncer that cut away from Yuvraj who checked his pull and it flew off the top edge over the keeper!
slower cutter, forced down to left of long-off for couple of runs
shortish delivery, mistimes the pull to midwicket for a single
moves outside leg and heaves to Umesh at deep midwicket
low full toss on the middle, heaved away to right of Umesh at deep midwicket region
full and straight from the bowler and the batsman too goes straight down the ground. He smacked that really hard
full and moving away from Yuvraj, who ends up slicing an attempted big hit and it lands safely beyond the off-side 30-yard circle
slower one outside off and Parnell adjusted to the slower pace and dragged it to deep midwicket
fullish delivery on the off, driven straight to short extra cover
a wide down the leg side.
Killer strike! What a lovely clean swing of the bat. He opened up his stance and swung through the line of a length delivery outside off and down to the long-off boundary
low full toss this time, pushed through to deep cover
full delivery, on the middle and off, pushed out to left of Dinda who dives to stop it. No runs so far in this over.
the slow bouncer this time and a surprised Parnell chops it off the edge and on the bounce to the keeper
the back-of-the-hand slower one.. very s l o w  and Mishra waited. And waited. He finally went for the pull but Sehwag jumps at midwicket to pouch it.
goes down the track, but doesn't connect with the drive. The ball rolls off the inside half of the pad - he was struck outside the line of the leg stump - to the keeper.
the bouncer around off and Mishra pulls it to deep midwicket for a single
the super over continues. This is a yorker and Yuvraj digs it out to the off
slower one, on a length, around off and middle, turned to right of midwicket for a single
doesn't time as well as he would have liked but picks up a single with a drive to long-on
the slower bouncer, and it has been pulled away to fine-leg region
shortish delivery, Mishra goes for the pull but doesn't quite connect
yorker length delivery just outside off, squeezed out to short third man region
dabs this to the off for a single
Oh beautiful! Yuvraj backed away outside leg stump and adjusted to yet another slower one.. And he walloped through the line so neatly that it went sailing over long-off
drags this slower one through to deep midwicket region for couple of runs
goes for a pull shot and it lands safely wide to the left of long-on fielder
slower one from Irfan, on a length and on the middle line, punched out to long-on
around the off stump, pushed out to third man
another short delivery this time, Yuvraj takes his eyes off the ball and stabs it to fine-leg region for a single.
backs away and drives this full delivery to left of sweeper cover.
Over the keeper! Take your pick from the cliches: "You can't place a fielder for that," Or "Safest place on the field!"   ...   It was a bouncer and Yuvraj top-edged the pull
full in length, on the middle and leg, tucking up Yuvraj who defends
goes after this short and wide delivery outside off but doesn't connect
full delivery on the off and middle, for a moment I thought Yuvraj was going to go downtown but he lunged out to push it to mid-off
presses back to pull this to long-on for a single
gets back to push this to left of cover where Dinda makes a mess. Again.
lovely delivery. Turn and bounce. Mishra is beaten, pushing away from the body
goes down the track and tries to smash this over long-off but the ball turned a bit and he ended up slicing it, carving it a bit and couldn't clear long-off. Caught at the boundary
works this for a single
Massive! He took a step forward and whipped it up and over midwicket in some style. Great timing. That lovely big bat swing and it came down ferociously on the ball
And again.
shuffles across and goes for that pull shot but it wasn't all that short and he misses it completely
walked right across the stumps, gets outside and Umesh hurls it really full; Robin pushes it to mid-off
flicked away for a single
shuffles across and punches this length delivery to long-on for a single
around the off stump line, stabbed to the on side
gets back to push this delivery on middle and off line back to the bowler
drifts this outside leg and Yuvraj connects with the sweep shot this time,
on the middle and leg line, from a length, Yuvraj goes for the sweep but doesn't connect well
turns from the off stump, extra bounce as well, pushed out to sweeper cover
full on a length on the middle, defended back to the bowler
gets forward to jab this to the on side.
leans forward to drive to mid-off for a single. Umesh Yadav, who bowled too many short deliveries in his first over, corrected his length this time.
gets behind the line to defend this one to cover
overpitched outside off, squeezed out to backward point
short in length and outside off, run down to left of third man for a single
square drives this full delivery past point for a single
rising delivery outside off, tapped to third man
Finch seeks redemption and Ryder's entertaining knock ends. Ryder top edged this sweep shot and Finch came forward from deep backward square-leg to take this simple catch
worked through the on side for 2 runs
Aaron Finch follows Dinda's footsteps. Not a drop but a poor effort to stop this sweep shot from Ryder. Finch moved to his right and put his right hand out very casually. And missed.
50 from 24 balls for jesse; the 2nd-fastest of this IPl. Ryder went down the track and smashed this way beyond the long-on boundary
gets forward to defend to the on side of the pitch

Dropped by Dinda at deep midwicket. What a clanger! Ryder didn't connect as well as he would have liked with his slog sweep and Dinda positioned himself under the white ball and waited. And waited. And dropped it
in the zone outside off and Yuvraj is beaten, pushing inside the line
fullish delivery around off, eased to long-on
picks a single with a dab to left of backward point
rushes down the track, looking for the big hit over mid-off, but can't find the elevation and hits it straight to Warner at mid-off
Six over fine-leg boundary! Hopes tries the bouncer and Mithun Manhas hooks it up and over.
cuts from the off-stump line but its intercepted at backward point
Crowd killer! Ryder crashes this full delivery amidst the screaming fans beyond midwicket boundary. It was shaping to be a good over but that hit has upset Nadeem's figures.
gets back to nudge this to short fine-leg region for a single
quick again but pushes it wide down the leg side
quicker one, on the pads, turned to deep backward square-leg
this one turns from the middle line, dabbed to on side for a single
moves down the track, looking for the lofted hit but beaten by the dip and edges it to short third man
moves outside leg and drives straight to extra cover
tries the short ball, pulled away to deep midwicket
slips in a slower one down the leg side, rolls off the pad and the keeper dives
full in length, moving in to the pads, rolls away to the off side
Quick bouncer from Hopes and it screams over the batsman
leans forward to flick this full-length delivery through backward square-leg. They turn for second. Could have been risky but Umesh Yadav's throw is pretty wide at the non-striker's end.
full in length, on the middle, defended to midwicket
shortish delivery outside off, cut away to right of warner at wide third man
full in length on the middle, whipped through midwicket
Slasher! Low full toss outside off and the batsman crouches to slash it to third man boundary. Umesh Yadav winces.
finally, a full delivery and Ryder edges this to fine-leg. he was looking to drag this through wide mid-on
More violence. Imperious hitting. It was the short-pitched delivery outside off and Ryder carves it over point
The bouncer on the off and middle line. Blink. The ball is being thrown back from midwicket boundary. Feisty pull
Wow! What timing from Jesse! It was a length delivery on the off stump, Ryder stays adjacent to the line, opens the bat-face and sliced it through backward point. Fab timing.
gets back  and pulls this in the air towards deep square-leg
stays back to punch this  back to the bowler
"PRESSURE!" screams Brad hogg as Irfan pushes this wide outside off stump
keeper stands up and can only make a half-stop after Ryder misses a pull
Now he provides the meaning of boom. A gentle short of length delivery and its sailing over midwicket. Ryder had unfurled a crashing pull. Irfan fans, be worried, very worried!

Bosh! This was definition of bosh. It was a length delivery from Irfan who probably thought he had bowled a decent delivery. Ryder took a step forward and smoked through the line. Hit on the up. It screamed past Irfan
on the off stump line, pushed out to point

No need to appeal for this one. Dinda pumps his fists and roars. It was a short of length delivery angling away from Smith, who perhaps buoyant after a successful pull shot earlier in the over, goes for another. But this is going away from the off stump and he top edges it to Irfan at third man
Ryder, again, tries to do too much. He backs away and tries to punch this straight delivery. No room and he is cramped up but gets an inside edge to leg slip region
Another big swing and a miss. This was a length delivery just outside off and Ryder goes for the pull
fuller in length, just outside off, Smith tries to heave it to the on side and edges it through backward square-leg
Slam-pull! It was slightly short of length and Smith pulls it to the midwicket boundary. He fetched it from around off stump line and crashed it
goes for a big slog to the leg side, misses and is struck on the pads. It was outside leg
full length delivery around off, Smith goes hard into the on drive and ends up mistiming it to mid-on
leans across to knife this length delivery on the up and through point for couple of runs
moves outside leg and cuts this full-length delivery to point
takes a step forward and drives this gentle full delivery back down the track and Irfan stops it
Smith rushes down the track and has a big swing but misses. The ball bounces once before it reaches the keeper
leans forward to push this to mid-on
stays beside the line of a length delivery outside off and punches it to point
short in length, pulled away past square-leg for a single
stays behind the line to defend to the on side
full in length outside off stump, pushed out to mid-off
And salt and injury and all that jazz. Smith whips this full-length delivery to square-leg boundary

Edge? Surely? Huge noise! What's happening out there! It was a shortish delivery well outside off and Smith went for the cut and there was huge noise and edge. Half-hearted appeal, though. Why? Oh dear...
pushes this back to the bowler
More fun from Ryder. He went down on his knee, fetched this from outside off and absolutely thumped this over long-on
Thumpy thump! Jesse goes down town. He leaned forward and let the bottom-hand work over time. The ball soared over long-on
Top edges the slog sweep and Dinda moved in from deep midwicket but didn't reach the ball. He could have rushed faster . hmmm
stays back to punch it to cover
from round the stumps, on the middle stump line, nudged to the on side
Hopes finishes it off with a sliced drive over backward point! Good for the tournament that Delhi have pocketed their first win. Yuvraj shakes hands with Sehwag and pats him on the back with a smile
Game-breaking hit! Hopes has smashed this length delivery over the sightscreen!
The game refuses to die. Venugopal Rao, who has done so well here, clatters this short delivery straight to deep midwicket!
Venu is turning it on in style. He pulls this short delivery to fine-leg boundary. Super cool finish
What a whack! He took a step down the track, backed away to the leg in the process and absolutely creamed this one! He flat-batted this short of length delivery over long-on
just outside off, tapped to short third man for a single
slows up the pace further, fuller, driven to right of sweeper cover
Magical Yuvraj! Finch tries to back away and heave the slow delivery on the good length to the on side. The ball  gently lobs  back to Yuvraj! Finch gone after looting some quick runs
length delivery on the off, Venu edges the slog but it falls safely at mid-on .. well  beyond the reach of long-on fielder. 20 runs in that bonanza over
slower one this time, from round the stumps, forced away to deep cover
Wide this time! Wagh is crumbing under pressure here. he went round the stumps and hurled this wide outside off.
Blistering hit! A length delivery this time and Finch heaves it high over long-on! The game turns again
Another low full toss and Finch fetches it from well outside off and flays it over long-on
low full toss outside off, Finch makes contact with the bottom end of the bat and it falls well short of the fielder rushing in from long-off
full delivery wide outside off stump, Finch can't reach it
reaches outside off to steer this to point
full in length, cut away to backward point for a single
moves down the track and flat bats this to long-on
tries to repeat that shot but its intercepted at extra cover
backs away to the leg side and forces this one through extra cover.
And again. he doesn't reach the pitch of the ball but tries to go through the line and edges it to square-leg
moves down the track but Yuvraj shortens the length; pushed back to the bowler
leans forward to nudge this to midwicket
eases this to long-on for a single. 50 from 25
gets back to punch this past the lunging bowler for a single
short of length and Venu pushes this past the non striker
Thump! Venu sashays down the track and clubs this high over long-on boundary.
taps this towards wide midwicket for a single
slows up the pace as Venu goes down the track again. And its a clever move as a surprised Venu tries to stab it and is hit on the pad
moves down the track but doesn't quite reach the pitch and tries to defend. The ball rolls of his pad
stays back to punch this to long-off for a single
gets forward to nudge this to leg side for a single
Rushes down the track and smashes this over long-off. Brad Hogg screams. It appears it doesn't need much for him to clear his lungs. This was indeed a good shot
goes for the sweep but misses it completely. Robin collects outside off

Plumb! It landed around off stump and skidded in. Wade, who played an awkward shot against the earlier leg break as well, combusts. He goes for a pull but the ball skids on quickly to trap him. Finally, we shall see finch or Hopes out there
gets down the track to ease this to long-on
leans forward to glance it to short fine-leg
leg break on the middle and off line, Wade is cramped for room but manages to stab it to short third man
gets back on the middle stump line to work it to wide midwicket
leg break on the middle, the batsman shuffles across to dab it to short fine-leg fielder
gets forward to defend this to the off
this one came in with the arm and Venu stabs it off the inside edge to the leg side. Cry of agony from Yuvraj

The Pune captain is doing his magic. This one turned sharply from Naman who went for the big off drive and dragged his back foot in the air. Robin does really well to collect and whip off the bails! Yuvi is on a hatrick here
And Irfan, who was promoted to no 3, perishes now. He went for the slog sweep but doesn't connect all that well. Deep midwicket moves in to take a comfortable catch.
around the leg stump, paddled to short fine-leg fielder
full delivery outside off, pushed away for a single
extra bounce on this delivery that cuts back in from outside off, jabbed out towards mid-off region
slower delivery again, mistimes the cut to point
slower one, full in length, pushed out to covers
around the off stump line, tapped to point for a single
full in length around off, steered to backward point
gentle seam up delivery outside leg and Irfan helps it along to the fine-leg boundary
Gets down on his knee and plays the slog sweep to perfection. The ball lands in the deep midwicket stands
on the pads, turned towards square-leg
moves down the track, ends up getting too close to it and digs it out
full toss on the off, swatted away to long-off. Just a single
stays round the stumps to Irfan as well, on the middle and leg line, pushed  to the on side
on the middle and leg this time, eased to long-on
from round the stumps, floated outside leg
dabs this past backward point for a single

Clatter! Jesse screams and roars! It was a length delivery that skidded on towards middle stump. Sehwag went for a forcing shot and the ball cut in to move past the heave and crashed into the middle stump. Sehwag has a long chat with the new batsman
on the middle stump line, Sehwag backs away to late- cut it to third man boundary
fullish, on the middle, driven to long-off
slower cutter, dragged from outside off to midwicket
full in length, outside off, cut away to deep backward point
gets down the track and drills this to long-on
goes down the track and on drives to long-on
leg  break outside off stump, Sehwag is beaten on the cut
slower, leg break on the middle and leg, pulled away past square-leg
moves outside leg stump and carves this topspinner to deep point
leans forward to drive to left of the bowler who makes a half-stop
just clear of Yuvraj It was a weak pull and Yuvraj backpedaled at midwicket and jumped but the ball just about dipped over him
leans across to ping sweeper cover
gets forward to push it to the off side
works this towards long-on for a single

Dropped by Yuvraj IT was long-on's catch but Yuvraj decided to do it all by himself from straightish midwicket. It was heaved high towards wide long-on and Yuvraj ran back from midwicket .. Mishra ran in  from long-on but Yuvraj decided to lunge out and try taking it. Both men nearly collide and Yuvraj spilled the catch
clears the front foot and heaves this full delivery to wide long-on boundary
Warner is run out. It was turned just past square-leg and they came back for the second. Robin collected the throw on the bounce and broke the stumps. Gone!
stays back to work to vacant spaces in midwicket for couple of runs
threatens to move outside leg but comes back and forces it to long-on
moves outside leg and carves it over backward point!
quickish topspinner on the middle, defended off the back foot
flighted on the middle and leg, turned to midwicket
full in length, on the middle, whipped away to deep square-leg
slow bouncer outside off, left alone ... Robin fails to stop it
swing and miss. Full and outside off stump, Warner has a big heave at it but no wood on leather
the short ball this time as the bowler tries to correct his earlier mistake and Warner flat-bats it over covers
Ah! A full toss gift-wrapped and Warner goes down town. Clubbed!
on the middle stump line, full in length, worked past square-leg
this time he quickly moves to his left to collect another wide
Robin is not miked up now but he is unable to stop this wide delivery down the leg side. He lunged and seemed to have it covered but the ball died on him and went under his gloves
from round the stumps this time, full and straight, driven to mid-off
Warner is winning this contest with Thomas. Another shortish delivery and Warner flat-bats it over cow corner. Thump
Thomas tries the short ball. No luck. Warner whacks it up and over square-leg boundary. Poor delivery, it was just outside leg line
low full toss on the off-stump line and Warner stays back and crunches it to left of mid-off and it runs away to the boundary.
slower off cutter, Warner pushes it out to mid-off
very full delivery, pushed out towards mid-on for a single
lands on a length on the middle and straightens, Sehwag taps it to cover point for a quick single
Flayed away! It was the full delivery outside the off stump and Sehwag slices it up and over cover
straightens from a length on the middle stump line and Sehwag respects that length, to defend it back to the bowler
full inswinging delivery but on the pads and Sehwag whips it to backward square-leg boundary
on a length, around off, tapped past Sehwag for a single
goes for the yorker, it swings in late and Sehwag pushes the low swinging full toss to mid-on
punches this in the air but it falls just short of the lunging backward point fielder
Warner is in some mood. This was a length delivery well outside off and he flat-batted it to right of mid-off
full delivery, warner tries to whip it away past square-leg and ends up edging and dragging it to fine-leg boundary
shorter in length, Warner gets back to push it out to cover
goes for the big heave-ho to the leg side and ends up mistiming it to mid-off
Bosh. Full delivery just outside off stump, and Warner crashed it to left of mid-off
Crunchy! it was a short of length delivery angling away from Sehwag who went back and across to carve it over point
another good swinger, moving away late from the middle and leg line and warner gets a leading edge to mid-off as he tries to work it to the on side
outswinger outside off stump, pushed out to cover
full in length, just outside off stump, defended to point
punches this through covers for couple of runs
gets behind the line to defend the length delivery to the off side
a bouncer just outside off and Sehwag ducks
turns this to short fine-leg region for a single
shorter this time and Warner has no problem in connecting with the pull shot. Whack!
not all that short, skidding across Warner who tries to pull but doesn't connect
full in length, outside off, dabbed away to point
hint of inswing into the left-handed Warner, fullish delivery, stabbed to point
